Card Q&A.a: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] effect to digivolve it into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Insectoid]/[Free] trait in the trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] If it's your turn, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Insectoid] or [Free] trait in your trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
